title: VenusGenome: Genome-Aware Masked Autoencoding for Microbial Genome Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Genomic-context models have shown that contextualizing protein embeddings can improve predictions of microbial function. We observe that a gene's protein embedding is partially predictable from the embeddings of neighboring genes in the genome, motivating high-ratio masking that requires reconstruction from sparser genomic context. Genomic modeling must also distinguish biological relationships from assembly conventions, since the ordering of separate contigs does not imply adjacency and strand labels depend on the reference orientation. We therefore introduce VenusGenome, a gene-resolution masked autoencoder that combines visible-only encoding with genome-aware attention incorporating contig boundaries, relative strand orientations, and gene positions. We pretrain this model on a curated corpus of over 1.7 million microbial genome assemblies from isolate and metagenomic sources, using frozen protein embeddings as gene-level inputs. Ac

translated_title: VenusGenome：面向微生物基因组表示学习的基因组感知掩码自编码器
translated_abstract: 基因组上下文模型已经表明，为蛋白质嵌入提供上下文信息可以改善微生物功能的预测。我们观察到，一个基因的蛋白质嵌入可以从基因组中相邻基因的嵌入中部分预测出来，这促使我们采用高比例掩码策略，使模型必须从更稀疏的基因组上下文中进行重建。此外，基因组建模还必须区分真实的生物学关系与组装约定，因为独立重叠群（contig）之间的排序并不意味着物理上相邻，而链方向标签依赖于参考方向。为此，我们提出了VenusGenome，一个基因分辨率的掩码自编码器，它将仅可见编码与基因组感知注意力机制相结合，后者纳入了重叠群边界、相对链方向以及基因位置信息。我们在一个精选的语料库上预训练该模型，该语料库包含来自分离株和宏基因组来源的超过170万个微生物基因组组装，并使用冻结的蛋白质嵌入作为基因级输入。
tldr: 提出VenusGenome，一种基因分辨率的基因组感知掩码自编码器，通过高比例掩码与融合重叠群边界、链方向和基因位置的注意力机制，在超过170万个微生物基因组上预训练，以提升微生物基因组表示学习和功能预测能力。
en_tdlr: VenusGenome is a gene-resolution, genome-aware masked autoencoder that combines visible-only encoding with high-ratio masking and attention over contig boundaries, strand orientations, and gene positions, pretrained on over 1.7 million microbial genome assemblies for improved microbial function prediction.
